Jordan (partnerships): heads-up — HW Partner X portal shows ~1.9M tokens for March but our marketplace metering says ~2.3M. Can someone triage? https://vendor-portal.example.com/partners/X/usage :eyes:
Priya (finance): ugh ok. can you attach the partner CSV or a sample? we need day-by-day to reconcile totals.
Tomas (eng-platform): will pull the webhook receipts and the ingestion batch logs. quick note: we had a retry wave on 2026-03-14 due to a transient 502 in the ingestion endpoint. wondering if partner replayed?
billing-bot: daily_usage_batch 2026-03-15 completed. records_processed: 2345678; webhook_sent: 2345678; acks: true
Riley (platform): I just checked /logs/webhooks/marketplace/2026/03/14. There are duplicate event_id values for a handful of POSTs around 03:02 UTC — looks like the partner gateway retried without de-dupe headers. snippet: ```json
{"event_id":"evt_abc123","external_customer":"cust-987","meter":"tokens","amount":12000,"ts":"2026-03-14T03:02:10Z"}
```
Ava (partner-success): Partner support replied — they saw a flurry of 502s from your ingestion endpoint and their gateway retried automatically. They say their portal dedupes on external_id but only for batch uploads, not webhooks.
Jordan (partnerships): do we dedupe on event_id or external_id on our end?
Tomas (eng-platform): In the marketplace ingestion path we use marketplace_event_id as the unique key for market-sourced events. For partner direct webhooks we store raw_event_id + external_customer and have a 24h dedupe window keyed on (external_customer, meter_id, rounded_minute, amount) — which is weaker. That might let duplicates through if retries are slightly time-shifted.
Priya (finance): If duplicates got billed, partner will expect credits. what's the delta in $ roughly?
Tomas (eng-platform): rough calc: 400k extra tokens * $0.0001/token = $40. but that's sample; need exact per-interval.
Sam (legal): if we credit, we should log reconciliation ids and keep audit trail. also check contract clauses on retry-caused overages.
Riley (platform): quick triage plan: 1) run a DB query to find event_ids with count>1 for 2026-03-14..15 2) pull raw webhook payloads from S3 3) compare against partner portal CSV for external_ids 4) produce a reconciliation report.
Tomas (eng-platform): SQL I'll run: ```sql
SELECT raw_event_id, external_customer, meter_id, count(*) as dup_count
FROM marketplace_webhook_events
WHERE received_at BETWEEN '2026-03-14' AND '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY raw_event_id, external_customer, meter_id
HAVING count(*) > 1;
```
Jordan (partnerships): assign owners? Priya — finance to own credits calculation. Tomas — eng to run dedupe + produce reconciliation CSV. Ava — ask partner for their webhook retry logs and a portal export. Sam — legal standby. Riley — make sure ingestion dedupe window/logic notes go to the runbook.
Ava (partner-success): I'll ping them now and ask for the gateway logs + a CSV export for 2026-03-10..2026-03-16. I'll ask them to confirm whether their portal deduped the batch they show.
billing-bot: reconciliation_job started by Tomas at 2026-03-15T17:12:30Z
Tomas (eng-platform): I placed a read-only export at s3://redwood-metering/marketplace-recon/2026-03-14-15/partnerX_raw_events.csv.gz
Priya (finance): once Tomas posts the reconciliation CSV, I'll run the delta against billing rates and draft a credit memo. need total tokens overbilled and impacted invoice IDs.
Riley (platform): longer term, we should unify dedupe keys for marketplace vs partner webhooks and prefer event_id if supplied. I'll open a small RFC for a 30-day dedupe window and idempotency headers.
Sam (legal): +1 on RFC, cc finance for threshold where credits escalate to contract ops.
Jordan (partnerships): timeline? can we have initial recon by EOD PST?
Tomas (eng-platform): I'll have duplicate-event query + CSV by EOD PST.
Ava (partner-success): partner promised CSV within 6h.
Priya (finance): will block a slot at 3pm PT to review numbers.
Jordan (partnerships): great. thanks all. let's avoid billing surprises. :thumbsup:
Riley (platform): note for runbook: if retries suspected, flip ingestion to require Idempotency-Key header from partner gateway and ignore duplicates with same header for 24h. low-risk flag.
billing-bot: reconciliation_job completed. duplicates_found: 6 events; tokens_duplicate_total: 412000; suggested_credit: $41.20
Jordan (partnerships): OK closing once credit memo is issued. Ava please confirm with partner that they've disabled aggressive retries and will reconfigure dedupe for webhooks.
Ava (partner-success): will confirm and follow up here.
Priya (finance): I'll post the credit memo and add reconciliation IDs to the invoice thread.
Sam (legal): keep the audit logs attached.
Jordan (partnerships): thanks team — we'll update the partner success playbook with this edge case.
